notes.title: Fret Smasher Update v0.38 A2
notes.content: [h1]STREAMER VS CHAT![/h1][p]This is a brand new gamemode added with v0.38 A2 that allows Twitch streamers a new way to engage with their audience in Fret Smasher![/p][p]Simply navigate to the Settings Menu and scroll down to the Twitch Integration folder. To play this mode you must connect a Twitch account to Fret Smasher by entering the following:[/p][p][/p][p]- Oauth Key: This is a special log in key for the Twitch account that will listen to your chat. The account logged in does not need to be the one streaming, this is only for listening to your chat and sending out messages.[/p][p]- Nick: This is the username/nick of the account signing in with the Oauth key.[/p][p]- Channel: This is the channel you wish to listen to, aka the Twitch account/channel you are streaming on.[/p][p][/p][p]Once you have your sign in details made, you can adjust any further settings further down to refine the mode to work best for your streaming setup. Such as if you need longer vote times to account for latency or if you want Blitz Mode to activate or not.[/p][p]The mode has you playing through songs as you normally would using Classic Play settings however your viewers will be able to vote on what Battle Powerup the wish to send your way. By default they have 30 seconds to vote and when the time is up, the attack with the most votes wins and is applied. We then reset with a new vote and the streamer has to survive the ongoing attack. Very rarely will Blitz Mode activate after a vote which will decrease the vote time dramatically, by default it lowers down to 10 seconds. However battle powers will still last just as long so be prepared as attacks from your viewers will now end up stacking![/p][p]Try the mode with your viewers on Twitch and remember you are welcome to share your Fret Smasher streams to the[url="https://discord.gg/F8vZW85"] Fret Smasher Discord server[/url]. You just might attract a dev on the official Fret Smasher account to come watch![/p][p][/p][h2]Change-log:[/h2][h3]ADDITIONS[/h3][p]- NEW MODE: Streamer VS Chat![/p][p]- NEW BATTLE POWER: Broken String![/p][p]- Added a Miss Note Sounds toggle[/p][p][/p][h3]BUG FIXES[/h3][p]- Fixed an issue causing Career sorting to persist into other modes[/p][p]- Fixed an issue causing Scan Time sorting to break[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with Scan Time sorting to be inverted. Should now display most recently scanned songs at the top[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with the Score Display menu breaking upon 2nd use when accessing from the More Options Menu[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with added bots and career bots not using either the default highway or matching player 1's highway[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with the default highway being all black instead of using the default texture if the game fails to load a custom highway from the folders[/p][p][/p][h3]ADJUSTMENTS[/h3][p]- Steam Workshop upload prompts have been updated[/p][p]- Updated the credits with all up to date Patrons[/p][p]- Fret Stems will now expand to match the animated Fret height[/p][p]- Updated note hit logic for the held frets to be more consistent between conditions and to allow Broken String to function[/p]

notes.title: Fret Smasher Patch v0.37.5 A2
notes.content:
With Fret Smasher Patch 0.37.5a2, some of the most notorious bugs should be fixed.

One of our most reported bugs lately has been an issue where the audio desyncs with other stems/instruments. This error should hopefully be resolved in this update as the audio streams are now running with linked channels. If you experience any further issues, please verify your audio stem files are in sync if the song is a custom. If the song is one provided with the game, please report the issue to our Discord server. Now that this error is resolved, players should now also have an easier time calibrating their game as every stem will now be properly synced up to the game time.

Another one of our reported bugs has been from new players in the last few months. This was, scanning songs for the first time would falsely flag every song as a "Bad Song". The error has been located and should hopefully allow all new first scans to run successfully.


[b]Now for some new stuff.[/b]

Our themes has expanded. You can now swap out the audio files for the menus of the game. This is to test the waters of menu customisation for themes where hopefully sometime in the future, we can allow you to swap out menu textures too. See the theme template for a list of audio files you can change. On top of new audio changes, we also have some new UI textures that can be swapped. Battle mode powerup icons can now be changed in themes!

[b]AND FINALLY, we have a BRAND NEW SONG![/b]
Destination Devastation by JappWakka is now available in Fret Smasher.

notes.title: Fret Smasher Update v0.37 A2
notes.content:
[h1]The Renderer Update[/h1]
For v0.37 A2 we've built an entirely new rendering system for chart objects and highways. These overhauls will greatly improve the game's performance and also adds in new rendering techniques to give that extra edge of quality.

The new rendering system removes the need for game objects for each note and sustain entirely. 

Our old system relied on a note being a gameobject in the scene with each note having a note renderer and sustain renderer script attached. These scripts would slow the game down as each of them would run every frame. And with 50 notes in the note pool to start, that's 100 scripts per frame just for notes which just wasn't needed! In v0.36.2 A2, this issue was addressed where only the notes on screen would have these scripts running but it was still a MAJOR flaw as it would greatly slow the game down when large quantities of notes were rendered. The new system removes the need for gameobjects and a note pool entirely by offloading the rendering to the GPU instead of being very CPU oriented.

While working on these changes, shader updates for the notes and sustains were required so while doing so, we've made the move to overhaul how sustains operate when it comes to rendering the materials, colours and whammy animations. Now, you'll see a nice smooth blend of colours as you whammy for HyperFlux or even watch as the sustain fades away if it drops.

As for the highway renderer, it won't seem like anything is different but we've made some changes to just overall improve the performance and some changes that now allow video highways to scroll which can be toggled in the settings.


[h1]Theme Makers, Heads Up![/h1]
For starters, if you're using a theme in your game right now, check to see if it's compatible.

If you're a theme maker, be sure to check the new theme template for how themes should be put together now. Themes REQUIRE all note, beatlines and sustain textures to be within the theme to be loaded correctly. These same textures must also be the exact same canvas size as one another to be loaded correctly. So all notes must match, beatlines must match and sustains of their respective type (open/normal) to match in canvas size.

Sustain colours are no longer set to the texture but now set in the theme.ini file. The new sustain materials has a base texture that's coloured and an additive overlay texture that adds a white glow.

If you need assistance with creating themes, you can always join our Discord server for help.

notes.content:
[h2]Audio Stuttering/Skipping[/h2]
Very recently we had a well known streamer (Acai) check out our game on twitch where a major bug with the audio was discovered. This was an edge case scenario where only they were seeing these issues. To ensure that everyone regardless of hardware can have a smooth audio experience, we've added 3 new settings to the Calibration settings.

[b]Detect Audio Latency[/b] - This setting will observe your current device's audio latency from when an audio stream is triggered to when it's sent to the speakers. However keep in mind that if your using a wireless speaker setup, this doesn't detect latency to the actual speakers, just to the system audio player. So use the detected value as a minimum setting and move the audio offset up in value if further tweaking is needed.

[b]Desync Threshold[/b] - If you have been experiencing frequent audio stutters or skipping, this setting will find more useful results over cranking the audio buffer to high values. This setting will allow you to pick how much of a desync between audio and gameplay time needs to occur before a desync fix is attempted.

[b]Desync Interval[/b] - If putting the threshold above to a really small value is causing massive stutters, this setting will help allow you to keep the short threshold value without presenting audio issues. Increasing this setting's value will space out the interval between each desync check. So using these 2 settings, it's best to find a good balance between threshold amount and how often you want to check that threshold to keep the audio in sync as much as possible without causing audio stutters.

Big thank you to Acai for not only discovering this bug, but for also helping with the testing side of our fixes.

[h2]Bot Skill Overhaul[/h2]
We've overhauled our bots! Bots are no longer restricted to 4 skill levels but instead, 100 of them!
Set the bot skill from a value between 1 - 99 where level 100 is the original perfect skill.

We hope that introducing these levels will allow players to further test their skills in face-offs and battles against the bot along with custom careers having a more fine tuned skill applied to their boss battles.

These new bot skill levels will also be displayed in the results and gameplay allowing for players to share which bot level they were facing.

[strike]We also might have done this because the expert skill was completely overpowered in battle and too many players were attempting to fight that bot level over novice & advanced[/strike]

notes.title: Fret Smasher Update v0.30 A2
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

Thank you all for continuing to follow the development of Fret Smasher! After the release of v0.29 the team decided to take a well deserved break, however we’re back now and we’ve made many changes! You can see the full list of changes at the bottom of this post, but we’ll go over the 2 major features with v0.30.

[h2]AUDIO EFFECTS![/h2]
With this update we’ve added a reverb audio effect while Hyper Flux is active, and a Whammy Pitch option! By default the Whammy Pitch option will be disabled but you can turn it on under the audio settings in game. The reason Whammy Pitch is disabled by default is there are still quite a few issues with it since it was added quite late into the development of v0.30. Hyper Flux reverb however seems to be working as intended at the moment and is enabled by default but there will be adjustments to the way it sounds.

[h2]CUSTOM THEMES![/h2]
You’re reading that correctly! We’ve implemented the first version of custom user themes! Inside your game folder there will now be a “Themes” folder. You simply need to drag and drop themes into the “Themes” folder then select them in game! At the moment you are only able to swap and change the resolution of note, sustain, strikeline, and particle textures. However we plan to expand themes quite a lot in the future! If you’d like to know more about our theme system there is a readme included with the the default theme template found in your game folder. So far we have had great results with the current implementation, however we’re sure there are issues that are yet to be found so be sure to let us know if you find any!



[h2]Full Changlog:[/h2]

[h3][Additions][/h3]
- Added keys volume in settings
- Added instrument icons to the results screen
- Added dedicated section on Ready-Up screen for chart descriptions 
- Added back the health bar so you can now fail songs!
- Added chart modifiers
- Added modal after title screen
- Added back cheats
- Added mute track on miss
- Added custom theme support!
(This is experimental, please report any issues!)
- Added whammy distortion
